product_summary: RSWM Limited (LNJ Bhilwara Group flagship) is an integrated textile manufacturer, not a food/FMCG company. Confirmed product lines from rswm.in: (1) Synthetic yarns - engineered man-made fibre yarns, incl. PV (polyester/viscose) blended greige yarn; (2) Cotton yarns - ring-spun and open-end cotton yarn; (3) Melange yarns - fibre-dyed and yarn-dyed melange, the company's signature line; (4) Denim fabric - 32 MN metres/year, 3000+ variants, 178 looms, incl. ecru fabric and shirtings; (5) Knitted fabric (LNJ Knits, since 2022) - single jersey, interlock, rib, pique, terry, fleece, ottoman, honeycomb, waffle, 120-400 GSM, from cotton, Pima, Supima, viscose, modal, Tencel, bamboo, nylon and polyester blends; (6) Recycled polyester fibre (R-Value, bottle-to-bottle at Ratlam MP). Plant list: Kharigram, Kanya Kheri, Mandapam, Ringas (Sikar), Rishabhdev (Udaipur), Lodha & Mordi (Banswara), Chhata (Mathura), Ratlam (MP).
comment: HS 5509.53 = yarn of synthetic staple fibres, mixed mainly with cotton, not put up for retail sale. This is a real and plausible line for RSWM (PV/cotton-blended synthetic staple yarn is explicitly produced at Lodha and Rishabhdev), so the declared code is CORROBORATED IN SUBSTANCE but is only ONE of many product lines - status: partial. Per Rule 3 the company is NOT rejected; the code is kept and the list is corrected/expanded. Key findings: (a) INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION - the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is plainly wrong; RSWM is a textile manufacturer (yarn, denim, knits, recycled polyester fibre). This is a data-entry error on the buyer side, not a supplier fault. (b) The declared single HS-6 code covers only yarn; the company's actual output spans three distinct HS chapters: Ch.55 (synthetic staple yarns 5509.xx, 5515.xx; synthetic staple fibre 5503.xx/5504.10; recycled polyester fibre), Ch.52 (cotton yarn 5205.xx; cotton woven fabric 5208-5212), and Ch.60 (knitted fabrics 6004/6005/6006). Denim (Ch.52 woven, indigo-dyed) and knitted fabric (Ch.60) are entirely MISSING from the declaration. (c) TRADER SIGNS: none - RSWM is a vertically integrated manufacturer with 5.84 lakh spindles, 178 looms and 130 knitting machines, and its own plant list; no evidence of pure trading. (d) 'LNJ APPAREL' as a unit name is not separately evidenced on rswm.in - the site names the divisions 'LNJ Denim' and 'LNJ Knits', not 'LNJ Apparel'. The unit identity is therefore заявлено, не подтверждено; the parent RSWM Limited product range is confirmed. (e) All product data above comes from the company's own website (rswm.in home, /our-presence, /knits, /denim) - i.e. catalogue/website claims, NOT customs lines. No customs/B-L record was checked in this task, so every HS code listed is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; only the product existence is corroborated by the manufacturer's own published plant and capacity data. (f) Note the site's own email domain typo 'info.rswm@Injbhilwara.com' (lowercase L rendered as I) - cosmetic, not a red flag. No registry, revenue or customs research performed per role scope.
